ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $P(12, a)$ lies on the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{60}{x}$. Line $PH$ is perpendicular to the $x$-axis at point $H$. What is the value of $\tan \angle POH$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $P(12,a)$ lies on the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{60}{x}$,\\
thus $a=\frac{60}{12}=5$,\\
therefore, $P(12,5)$,\\
therefore, $OH=12$, $PH=5$,\\
thus, $\tan \angle POH=\frac{PH}{OH}=\boxed{\frac{5}{12}}$.
